title: 2011 AMC 10B Problem 8
statement: At a certain beach if it is at least \(80^{\circ} F\) and sunny, then the beach will be crowded. On June \(10\) the beach was not crowded. What can be concluded about the weather conditions on June \(10?\)

answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text:
The temperature was cooler than \( 80^{\circ} \)F and it was
not sunny.

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text:
The temperature was cooler than \( 80^{\circ}
\)F or it was not sunny.

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text:
If the temperature was at least \( 80^{\circ}\) F, then it was
sunny.

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text:
If the temperature was cooler than \( 80^{\circ}\) F, then it
was sunny.

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text:
If the temperature was cooler than \( 80^{\circ} \)F, then it
was not sunny.

solutions.text:
The statement says that if the weather was at least \(80^\circ F\) and sunny, then the beach was crowded.

Because the beach was not crowded, the two conditions could not both have been true. Therefore the temperature was cooler than \(80^\circ F\), or it was not sunny, or both.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Use the contrapositive of “hot and sunny implies crowded”
Not crowded means at least one of the two conditions failed
